intersection=true`) (5) lane_change_urban -> straight: label `lane change complete`, required guard 'lane change complete' (PlantUML line 31: `lane_change_urban --> straight : lane change complete`) collision_avoidance_deactive -> collision_avoidance_active: label `pedestrian_detected || (dist_to_rear<5 && vel>30) || (dist_to_front<15 in HighwayMode || dist_to_front<10 in UrbanMode)`, required guard 'pedestrian_detected OR (dist_to_rear<5 AND vel>30) OR (front_distance<15 in highway mode) OR (front_distance<10 in urban mode)' (PlantUML line 46: `collision_avoidance_deactive --> collision_avoidance_active : pedestrian_detected || (dist_to_rear<5 && vel>30) || (dist_to_front<15 in HighwayMode || dist_to_front<10 in UrbanMode)`) (8) collision_avoidance_active ->
